description: We are CURIOSITY IS LIVE, tackling the "Abandoned but not Forgotten" challenge! Inspired by NASA's rovers, we want to bring the stories of discarded hardware on the Moon and Mars to life through interactive storytelling and data. Looking for creative developers, UI/UX designers, 3D/visual artists, and science storytellers to join our mission. Let’s make space history unforgettable
summary: Project Curiosity Is Live is an interactive storytelling platform that brings the forgotten hardware on the Moon and Mars back into the spotlight. Addressing the "Abandoned but not Forgotten" challenge, our project transforms NASA mission data, landing coordinates, and engineering logs into an immersive visual timeline. Users can explore discarded rovers, landers, and scientific instruments, learning how each piece of equipment paved the way for modern space exploration. By turning static archival data into an engaging narrative experience, our solution preserves aerospace history and inspires future generations to value the legacy behind every space mission.
details:
How It Works & Features
Project Curiosity Is Live allows users to navigate an interactive map and timeline of discarded NASA equipment across lunar and Martian surfaces. Selecting an artifact reveals its mission story, technical specifications, and scientific contributions.

Tools & Technologies

  • Data Sources: NASA Open Data Portal, Planetary Data System (PDS), and historical mission archives.

Impact & Creativity
Instead of treating retired hardware as space debris, we frame each object as a silent pioneer. Combining accurate orbital/surface data with accessible storytelling makes complex aerospace engineering understandable for students, educators, and space enthusiasts worldwide
